name: Question 19
problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2}a=6b \\ 2a-7b=5 \\ 2a-4b+\frac{3}{2}=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2}a-6b=0 \\ 2a-7b=5 \\ 2a-4b=-\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2} & -6 \\ 2 & -7 \\ 2 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2} & -6 & 0 \\ 2 & -7 & 5 \\ 2 & -4 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

{72a=6b2a−7b=52a−4b+32=0

a

Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered a,b on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

{72a−6b=02a−7b=52a−4b=−32

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

[72−62−72−4]

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

[72−602−752−4−32]
